meta.title: Amazon 官方政策历史回测样本（最多 10 条）
meta.purpose: 用真实、可核查的 Amazon 官方公开公告，检验 Radar 的规则准入与标签在历史政策上的表现；同时为第一主线的「抽检 10 条事实准确性」提供可复核的原始依据。

gateEvidenceFamilies: 原有卖家规则句式（removing the requirement / no longer need to / fewer than N orders / policy change 等）
参与方式切换：同一句内同时出现 opt-in 与 opt-out，且指向 program / enrollment / inclusion / participation
明确生效日期 + 政策主体：effective / takes effect / goes into effect 与库容、费率、政策、资格等主体在 ±160 字符内同时出现

classification.政策变化: 平台对卖家义务、费用、权限或流程做出带生效含义的变更（通常有明确生效日期）
classification.项目规则: 卖家参与某官方项目的资格、义务或参与方式发生变更，卖家需要据此调整操作
classification.功能上线: 新增工具、界面、报表或权益，不改变卖家义务与资格
classification.营销内容: 会议、活动、优惠、品牌宣传

meta.decisionRule: 人工判定为「政策变化」或「项目规则」= 期望入库（accept）；「功能上线」或「营销内容」= 期望拒绝（reject）。引擎结论与期望一致为 pass，不一致为 fail，原文或元数据无法核实为 unconfirmed。

evidenceBasis.fullBody: amazon-policy-backtest-bodies.json 保存 10 条样本的官方正文原文、抓取时间与 sha256；测试用它对当前分类器重新判定，engine 字段不是判定依据。
evidenceBasis.excerpt: gateText 是从同一份正文逐字截取的决定性句子，只用于「摘录回归」辅助断言（摘录结论必须与完整正文一致）。
evidenceBasis.hashes: 测试会重算每份正文的 sha256，正文被改动时直接失败，避免手写或替换全文。

meta.provenance: 标题、链接、发布日期均由项目自身的 fetchWebList / fetchDetail 读取官方页面得到；9 条公告的列表标题与详情 h1、列表日期与详情 datePublished 全部一致（2026-10-22 实测）。
meta.boundary: 本文件是历史回填样本，不写入生产库，不代表最新生产公告；生产覆盖率与回测准确率分别统计，不互相替代。正文原文仅用于本地可核查验证，不对外转载（来源 site_fulltext=false）。

samples.publishedAtNote: 列表 .PagePromo-date 与详情 datePublished 均为 2026-05-22。

samples.scope: 使用 Customer Service by Amazon（付费客服代管）的自配送卖家：无退货退款条件、免费资格门槛

tags: 亚马逊卖家项目规则线索

samples.admissionPath: 公告正文门禁（原有卖家规则证据）
samples.gateText: Fewer refunds We’ve updated our process to reduce instances where buyers are granted a refund without needing to return the product, which is known as a “return-less” refund. These changes ensure that return-less refunds only occur when the customer has not received the product by the promised timeline, they received a damaged or defective product that is non-returnable, or the product is unsafe to return. Get time back from managing SAFE-T claims You no longer need to manage SAFE-T claims for refunds related to delivery issues if you purchase ”claims protected” labels through Amazon Buy Shipping or Veeqo . We’ve also made it easier to qualify for the free program by removing the requirement of maintaining a 95% valid tracking rate. Plus, the program is now free if you are a low-volume seller with fewer than 30 orders per quarter.

samples.gateText: New expanded product categories The program has been expanded to include five popular product categories. Grade and Resell ASIN inclusion The Grade and Resell ASIN inclusion feature introduces a new opt-in approach that transforms how sellers participate in the Grade and Resell program. With the new ASIN inclusion feature, sellers gain more precise control over their Grade and Resell enrollment by taking an “opt-in” approach rather than an “opt-out” approach. Sellers can now handpick up to 2,000 ASINs that they want to include in the program or enroll their entire catalog, excluding specific items.

samples.title: Inbound shipping is now easier with the Amazon Partner Carrier program’s smart carrier options
samples.publishedAtNote: 列表 .PagePromo-date 与详情 datePublished 均为 2024-09-30。
samples.effectiveDateEvidence: 正文为 now have access，无生效日期。
samples.scope: 使用 FBA 与 AWD 的美国站卖家入库运输（Partner Carrier 智能承运商选项）
samples.note: 诱饵：正文出现 program 与 capacity-aware，但没有规则变更或生效日期。
samples.gateText: Sellers who use Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) and Amazon Warehousing and Distribution (AWD) now have access to smart carrier options when sending inventory to the Amazon network. Available through the Amazon Partner Carrier program, these options allow sellers to choose their preferred partner carrier and method of transport from a dynamic list that includes capacity-aware freight-ready dates and cost estimates to better optimize their business.

samples.title: Report brand violations faster with one guided experience
samples.publishedAtNote: 列表 .PagePromo-date 与详情 datePublished 均为 2026-07-31。
samples.scope: 已注册 Brand Registry 的品牌方举报流程（Report a Violation 工具改版）
samples.note: 诱饵：正文出现 store policy violations（命中政策主体词），但没有生效日期，因此不得放行。
samples.gateText: To help sellers more easily safeguard their brand, the Report a Violation tool in Amazon Brand Registry now offers a single, guided experience for reporting intellectual property (IP) infringement, store policy violations, and regulatory compliance concerns. Structured forms walk you step-by-step through the reporting process, and a Submission History tab tracks every report’s status in real time. Brands must be enrolled in Brand Registry to access Report a Violation.
